:::{#sol-flat-point-minimum}

The [flat point](#def-flat-point) is $w = 2$, from @sol-flat-point-find.
Evaluating $f$ there gives

$$
\begin{aligned}
f(2) &= 4 - 8 + 7 \\
&= 3.
\end{aligned}
$$

This is the [minimum](algebra.qmd#def-minimum) of the [values](functions.qmd#def-value) of $f$.
Completing the square, $f(w) = (w - 2)^2 + 3$,
since

$$
\begin{aligned}
(w - 2)^2 + 3 &= w^2 - 4w + 4 + 3 \\
&= w^2 - 4w + 7,
\end{aligned}
$$

and $(w - 2)^2 \ge 0$,
so $f(w) \ge 3 = f(2)$ for every $w$.
Equivalently, the [derivative](calculus-derivatives.qmd#def-derivative) is negative below $w = 2$
and positive above it,
so the function falls into that point and rises out of it.

:::
